title: The Empty Berth
text: At the east end of the first row the ash has been scraped flat and levelled: a berth the size of a hull, with mooring rings set into the rock. Nothing in it. On the nearest ring a plate, newly stencilled, without a speck of dust on it. ACCORD 12. Under it, smaller: LEDGER 12.

lines.text: "That's our serial. It's on the Command Core's hatch. I went and checked it twice before I said anything."
"There are two more berths like it, at the ends of the other rows. KINDRED 12. ENGRAM 12. All three swept clean."

choices.label: "Waiting for what?"
choices.reply: Nobody answers. The drones measure the berth: it is exactly our length, to the centimetre.

choices.label: Log it and move on
choices.reply: Logged: berth, empty, serial ours. You file it under things to think about later. The file is getting long.

tags: act 2, ash, hull field, clue, ledger
notes: LEDGER 12 on the plate is the thread to Vess (the-ledger).
